conflict_detection.definition: A review or comment is a NACK when the body matches \bNACK\b and not 'not a nack', or when the GitHub review state is CHANGES_REQUESTED.
conflict_detection.sample: convenience sample of the first 10 hits walking enriched_prs.jsonl, 2026-11-09. Not a random sample.
conflict_detection.sample_result: 3 of 10 are DrahtBot templates quoting another person's NACK. 6 of 10 are CHANGES_REQUESTED notes without the word NACK. 1 of 10 is a reply that quotes a NACK. Zero of the 10 are an unquoted NACK by the commenter.
conflict_detection.reason: n=10 and the walk is not random, so no precision rate is published.

resolution_times_2026.reason: Open pull requests have no decision time and are excluded. 2026 is not a completed year.

contributor_dossiers.limit: A dossier hit is a keyword match, not a reviewed identity.

closed_unmerged.reason: The dump has a draft boolean and no GitHub state_reason, so withdrawn and rejected are not separated. The remainder is not labeled rejected.

funding_mentions.reason: Most funding is never named in a pull request.
